name: Ponderous

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: The armor has moving parts or other complications that lengthen the wearer's initial reaction time. While wearing the armor, you take a –1 item penalty to initiative rolls. If you don't meet the armor's required Strength score, this penalty increases to be equal to the armor's check penalty if it's worse.
